about: Enhanced A gory ballet of bullets, Grave refuses to take cover and retreating isn't in his vocabulary. Rush at full speed, shooting your enemies faster and more mercilessly than ever before. Graphically enhanced for PlayStation®5.
Changed As the ultimate killing machine, experience the stylish shooting action with straight to the point controls.
With the cerberus pistol that has infinite magazine capacity and the death hauler, a transforming coffin, its time to unleash vengence.

Better than Ever Discover the story of Grave and his crew who set out on a great adventure to Southeast Asia in this beautifully brutal thrid-person action shooter, combining the best that East and West game design have to offer.
